exp.title: Under the Hood
exp.ast.title: AST-based Static Code Analysis
exp.ast.desc: Our platform performs deep static and dynamic code analysis locally. It parses through millions of lines of code to detect buffer overflows, backdoors, and logic flaws before production.
exp.ast.resp1: Implemented AST-based static code analyzers for C, Go, Rust, and JavaScript.
exp.ast.resp2: Constructed custom vulnerability rule definitions according to OWASP and CWE benchmarks.
exp.ast.resp3: Integrated local automated audit suites into offline CI/CD pipelines.
exp.zeroNet.title: Zero-Network Leakage
exp.zeroNet.desc: Armorix runs fully offline: not a single packet leaves the network interface during a scan, so project code, secrets and .env files stay on your laptop.
exp.zeroNet.resp1: Engineered automated offline vulnerability scanning routines with zero network leakage.
exp.zeroNet.resp2: Developed high-performance heuristics for rapid anomaly detection in air-gapped systems.
exp.zeroNet.resp3: Completely disabled telemetry and third-party tracking.
exp.crypto.title: Cryptographic Reporting
exp.crypto.desc: A fully offline technical audit report after every scan — to hand to a client, attach to a PR or share with your team. Scan results are never transmitted over the internet.
exp.crypto.resp1: Built tamper-evident offline PDF and JSON export engines with local digital signatures.
exp.crypto.resp2: Report generation sends zero network requests — zero telemetry by design.
exp.crypto.resp3: Optimized database indexing for instant querying of massive offline audit logs.

lab.title: Trace the Taint Flow in 3D
lab.lead: Pick a vulnerable sample and run the scanner: Armorix builds the AST, traces untrusted data from source to sink and applies a patch — all in your browser, without a single network request.
lab.s1.desc: External input is copied into a 64-byte stack buffer via strcpy() with no length check.
lab.s1.fix: strcpy() → snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), …): writes are now bounded by the buffer size.
lab.s2.desc: s->last_ping is written after delete s — access to freed memory (use-after-free).
lab.s2.fix: The write moved before delete and the pointer is set to nullptr.
lab.s3.desc: An HTTP parameter is interpolated straight into SQL via an f-string — SQL injection.
lab.s3.fix: The query is parameterised: the value is bound separately by the driver (?).
lab.s4.desc: The host parameter is concatenated into an sh -c command — OS command injection.
lab.s4.fix: Shell removed: argv array plus allowlist regexp validation.
about.title: What is Armorix?
about.lead: Armorix is a static analysis engine that finds and fixes vulnerabilities, memory bugs and misconfigurations in source code without an internet connection. No pentester to hire, no code shipped to the cloud: your code, findings and reports never leave your machine.
about.c1.title: Air-gapped isolation
about.c1.desc: Works fully with the network cable unplugged. Not a single request leaves the box.
about.c2.title: AST-level analysis
about.c2.desc: Reads the syntax tree, not lines of text: JavaScript / TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, Java, C and C++.
about.c3.title: Local neural engine
about.c3.desc: Ollama, Qwen, Llama on your own GPU. No API keys, no token bills.
about.c4.title: Automated patches
about.c4.desc: A ready diff for every finding, plus an ECDSA-signed audit report.
numbers.n1.label: Outbound traffic
numbers.n1.desc: Telemetry, DNS lookups and update checks are off. Not one packet reaches the network interface during a scan.
numbers.n2.label: Local CVE/CWE signatures
numbers.n2.desc: The whole database lives on disk. Updates ship as a signed offline bundle — even over USB.
numbers.n3.label: Lines of code / minute
numbers.n3.desc: The multi-threaded AST parser uses every CPU core you have.
numbers.n4.label: Offline functionality
numbers.n4.desc: Scan, analysis, patch and report — none of it depends on a cloud.
steps.title: How it works
steps.lead: From install to a signed report — five steps.
steps.s1.title: Install
steps.s1.desc: One binary or a Docker image. No account, no sign-up, no internet.
steps.s2.title: Scan
steps.s2.desc: Sources become a syntax tree and every call is indexed.
steps.s3.title: Analyze
steps.s3.desc: Untrusted data is traced from source to sink and matched against CWE/OWASP rules.
steps.s4.title: Patch
steps.s4.desc: The local neural engine proposes a ready diff patch for every finding.
steps.s5.title: Report
steps.s5.desc: A cryptographically signed audit report — tamper-evident and verifiable offline.
why.title: Why Armorix?
why.lead: Cloud SAST ships your code to someone else's servers, and an external audit is slow and expensive. Armorix does all the work on your laptop.
why.w1.title: Air-gapped isolation
why.w1.desc: Works on a train, in a café or with Wi-Fi switched off. Client code and .env files never leave your laptop.
why.w2.title: Zero-network telemetry
why.w2.desc: No analytics, no crash reports, no license phone-home.
why.w3.title: Local neural engine
why.w3.desc: A context-aware model runs on your GPU — the code never leaves the machine.
why.w4.title: Memory-safety detection
why.w4.desc: CWE-120 buffer overflow, CWE-416 use-after-free, CWE-190 integer overflow — deep rules for C/C++.
why.w5.title: Cryptographic audit report
why.w5.desc: ECDSA-signed PDF and JSON: your client or teammate verifies offline that the report hasn't been altered.
why.w6.title: CI/CD integration
why.w6.desc: pre-commit hook, VS Code, GitHub Actions and GitLab CI — on your own runner, without the code leaving it.
footer.title: Your code stays on your machine.

devs.title: Skip the pentest invoice — audit your own code.
devs.lead: Armorix isn't built for banks or government agencies — it's built for developers. A solo developer can't hire a security specialist: an external audit is expensive and takes weeks. And sending code to a cloud scanner means handing it to someone else's server. So we brought the AI to your laptop.
devs.vs.them.label: External pentest / audit
devs.vs.them.note: and thousands of dollars — to review a single release
devs.vs.us.label: Armorix
devs.vs.us.note: on every commit, on your machine, no token or cloud bills
devs.p1.title: Web & full-stack developers
devs.p1.desc: React, Next.js, Express, Django, Laravel — catches SQL injection, XSS, IDOR, exposed .env files and hardcoded keys before you deploy.
devs.p2.title: Freelancers & small teams
devs.p2.desc: Audit a project before handing it to the client and ship a signed report with it — no pentest budget needed.
devs.p3.title: Maintainers & learners
devs.p3.desc: Check every PR locally with a pre-commit hook and learn the CWE behind every finding.
devs.localhost.title: Running locally doesn't mean protected.
devs.localhost.desc: Plenty of web developers assume code is protected because it runs on their own machine. After deploy, that same SQL injection, leaked API key and loose CORS policy are on the open internet. Armorix finds the flaw while the code is still on your laptop — before it ships.
